articles.headline: Donald Trump considers executive order on NCAA athletes' employment status
articles.description: President Donald Trump is considering an executive order that would require federal authorities to clarify whether college athletes can be considered employees of their schools.

images.name: Todd Golden Donald Trump [1296x729]
images.caption: Florida men's basketball coach Todd Golden presents President Donald Trump with a uniform with his name on it as Trump hosted the Gators to celebrate their 2025 NCAA championship at the White House on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Michigan State forward Isaac Howard wins Hobey Baker award
articles.description: Michigan State junior forward Isaac Howard won the Hobey Baker Memorial Award on Friday as college hockey's top player, claiming the honor over finalists Zeev Buium of Denver and Boston College's Ryan Leonard, now with the Capitals.
